openspec.rationale: Primary engine. Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; version matches package.json. Needs Node.js 22.12.0+ (enforced by lib/platform/openspec). DEFAULT engine: detection order is pinned > openspec > speckit > native-kbd.
openspec.adapter: os* in lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs (CLI-backed, spawned with no shell)

speckit.rationale: Supported backup engine. Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; adapter is markdown-based (no specify CLI is ever invoked) and the version is pinned for layout conformance with specs/<NNN-slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}, verified against v1.3.0 on 2026-11-05.
speckit.adapter: sk* in lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs (pure filesystem markdown parsing)
speckit.notes: install: uv tool install specify-cli --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v1.3.0; init: specify init --here --force --non-interactive --integration <harness>; artifacts under .specify/ and specs/<slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}; tasks.md is a markdown checklist "- [ ] T001 description"

native-kbd.rationale: Compatibility engine for projects that already keep native changes or pin native-kbd; not offered as a default. Repo-owned; version tracks this repo, no external pin.

customEngines.hint: To plug in another spec engine, add an adapter object to the specEngines registry in lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs implementing the five ops (list/progress/markDone/verify/archive) under the uniform (root, change, ctx) shape, add its detection shape to detectBackend and its id to the project.json specBackend pin values, then register its metadata here.
